authors: Yuhang Wang, Xiaotong Liu, Haotian Chen, Tao Yang, Xingchen Liu and Xiaodong Wen
algorithm_long: AlchemBERT fine-tunes BERT-base-cased with a scalar prediction head on natural-language descriptions of materials. Composition tasks use chemical formulas or alloy fractions; structure tasks additionally describe lattice, symmetry, atomic sites and local environments. This submission contains the natural-language-input results for all 13 Matbench v0.1 tasks and five official folds, from the work published in Cell Reports Physical Science (2025).

notes: Metrics for all 13 tasks and 65 folds are recomputed from the unchanged archived predictions using current Matbench scoring, including probability-based classification ROC-AUC. This is a scoring correction, not model retraining. See README.md, RESULTS.md, RESCORING.md, INPUT_AUDIT.md, PAPER_EVIDENCE.md and RUNNING.md for the score comparison, source and input audits, training/recording tools and remaining historical provenance limits.
